name: fluttereasylocalization
description: Helps to extract strings into localization files, generate the keys and replaces the string with the localization key.

commands.title: EasyLocalization: Extract translation for this file
EasyLocalization: Extract translation as general purpose string
EasyLocalization: Regenerate all keys from translation files

fluttereasylocalization.translationDir.markdownDescription: The directory where the translation files are stored, relative to the Flutter project root.

fluttereasylocalization.generalTranslati.markdownDescription: The prefix for general purpose translation keys. It is used to distinguish between general purpose translations and file specific translations.

fluttereasylocalization.fileTranslationP.markdownDescription:
The separator inserted between the file-derived prefix and the key name for the *Extract translation for this file* command.

The current file's name (snake_case) is converted to camelCase to build the prefix — e.g. `home_page.dart` becomes `homePage` — and this separator joins it to the key you enter. With the default `_`, the key `welcome` becomes `homePage_welcome`. Set it to an empty string for no separator (`homePagewelcome`).

fluttereasylocalization.sortKeysAlphabet.markdownDescription: Whether or not to sort the keys alphabetically in the translation files. This applies after each new generation of translation entries.

fluttereasylocalization.generatedKeyFile.markdownDescription: The directory where the generated key file is stored, relative to the Flutter project root.
The name of the generated key file for Flutter. It is recommended to add `lib/**/*.g.dart` as an analyzer exclude in your `analysis_options.yaml` file.

scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
